title: Algerian White Bean Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Algeria, made with white beans, navy beans, and flavorful spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add navy beans, light kidney beans, Algerian spices, and vegetable broth. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
